data.readmeSummary:
## UK Businesses Without a Website

Aggregates and normalizes organisation-level records from official UK registers to produce prospect lists of organisations that have no website listed; the Actor pulls entries from the Care Quality Commission (CQC) care directory, the Charity Commission register, and the Department for Education Get Information About Schools (GIAS), applies sector and geographic filtering, and returns standardized rows containing organisation identity, location (address, postcode, outward code, local authority, region), sector and organisation type, a size indicator (pupil counts, income, or provider size), registration date, source identifiers and a link back to the original register entry. Coverage includes regulated care locations in England (care homes, GPs, dentists, homecare, hospices), registered charities in England & Wales (with a default income threshold bias), and open schools/academies/colleges/nurseries in England. Source datasets are maintained under OGL v3 and are refreshed on regular schedules (daily/weekly depending on the register).

## Use cases

- Building prospect lists for web agencies  
- Generating leads for freelance web developers  
- Sourcing potential customers for SaaS site builders
